title: Summer night low
description: Elhub summer low hour 2026-07-12T06:00:00+02:00: each price area and Elhub group at its metered demand (elhub:consumption-per-group-mba-hour; national 10493 MW), shared by its loads in proportion to their reference demand. Dispatch (rule reference-hour-dispatch): ENTSO-E measured 437 MW wind, 2264 MW run-of-river and 134 MW gas, shared by capacity (run-of-river units below their turbine's minimum stable loading committed per price area); HVDC links and the Nordic exchange at the measured flows (net export 1919 MW); storage hydro closes the balance at one common loading; losses are left to the slack. branchRatings rate overhead lines at 20 °C air (rule overhead-rating-at-0c). The Nordic remainder is at its summer-low inertia and load.

provenance.note: summerLow case: Kinetic energy: 2024 annual minimum 131 GWs × remainder share 77.0 % from the Fingrid map of the 2021-06-13 low-inertia hour = 101 GWs (the 2021 record low of 110 GWs gives 85 GWs). Load: SE+DK2 coincident summer-2025 minimum 10,154 MW + FI estimate 6,000–6,500 MW (Q3-2025 mean 8.15 GW × the 0.74–0.80 min/mean ratio of NO and SE) ≈ 16,400 MW. FCR-N 600 MW over ±0.1 Hz and FCR-D 1450 MW up / 1400 MW down for the Nordic area (2026 SOA LFCR parameters); Norway's 2026 obligation share is 38 %, so the remainder holds 62 %: FCR-N 372 MW = 3720 MW/Hz, FCR-D up 899 MW (linear 49.9→49.5 Hz), FCR-D down 868 MW. FFR up to 186 MW (62 % of about 300 MW) is procured only in low-inertia hours and is not included. aFRR: the Nordic 2026 volume of 200 MW each way (Appendix 1 to Annex LFCR 2026) less Norway's 31 % share = 138 MW.
